'''Master Nune's task force''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] was under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nunes]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]]. The task force, including the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Laudable]]'', along with Nunes and Kite were ultimately destroyed in an [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|ambush]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] in the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]].<ref name="Shakedown" />
